description: Address 5 correctness and safety issues identified in code review for src/doot/jobs.nim: phantom claim race, retryJob not resetting attempts, failJob dead maxAttempts parameter, scheduler duplicate insertion, and worker loop not verifying claim.
steps: 1. Fix phantom claim race in claimNextJob: use execAffectedRows and check if affected == 0 after the UPDATE, return none(JobRecord) if the lock failed.
2. Fix retryJob not resetting attempts: add 'attempts = 0' to the UPDATE in retryJob so manually retried jobs get a fresh retry budget.
3. Remove dead maxAttempts parameter from failJob: the proc always reads max_attempts from the DB row, so the parameter is misleading. Remove it and update all callers.
4. Add dedup guard in schedulerLoop: before inserting a scheduled job, check if a pending job of the same type already exists.
5. Add claim verification in workerLoop: after claiming a job, verify its status is 'running' in the DB before executing the handler.
6. Update tests to remove maxAttempts argument from failJob calls.
7. Add test for retryJob followed by failure (verifying attempts reset gives full retry budget).
8. Add tests for claim verification (phantom claim protection).
9. Add test for scheduler dedup guard.
acceptance_criteria: claimNextJob returns none when the UPDATE affects 0 rows (phantom claim protection)
retryJob resets attempts to 0 so retried jobs get full max_attempts budget
failJob signature has no maxAttempts parameter - always uses DB value
schedulerLoop does not insert duplicate pending jobs for the same job_type
workerLoop verifies claimed job status before executing handler
All tests pass including new tests for retry+failure and claim verification
